description: Records each golem's permission-gate / idle transitions to the central status feed (Notification); blocks destructive shell in read-only review/analysis subagents, and main-session destructive git aimed at another session's linked worktree, via a PreToolUse Bash guard (#448/#662); blocks worktree-escaping Edit/Write that would leak into the main checkout via a PreToolUse worktree-scope guard (#475); and blocks a golem's Read/Grep/Glob into a PEER golem's worktree via a PreToolUse read-scope guard (#630).
